summary.intent: Complete trail 167: an architecture cleanup (ARCH-4) that decouples the options types from the pipeline module, plus a docs pass correcting stale claims, and open PRs for both against main.
summary.outcome: Opened PRs #304 (ARCH-4) and #305 (docs) against main, both signed and mergeable. The worker saw 1067 tests pass and `just semver` passed all 196 checks. CI checks have not been read yet.

repo: Options types now live in `types/options.rs` and are re-exported by `pipeline`, so the resolver and dependency loader no longer import `pipeline`.

An architecture test enforces module dependency rules. Its 'until 2.3' allowlist was removed, rules for `dependency_types` and `types` were added, it now catches grouped `use crate::{...}` imports, and a negative test confirms it fires.
`just semver` runs 196 checks and is used to confirm no public paths moved during refactors.
Two module-level edges remain, each recorded with a reason in the architecture test: `types/options.rs` names the plugin registry, and `resolver/mod.rs` holds `DependencyLayer`.
ADRs are annotated with dated status notes rather than rewritten. ADR 0007 now states that discovery is not yet implemented.

code.finding: Lines 3 and 7 may conflict with PR #300 if it merges before #305.

workflow: Each stale doc claim was verified by grep against the code before editing.
Work is organized as numbered trails, each producing its own branches and PRs. Trail 166 is deferred until `t165-lints` finishes and the CPU is quiet.
PRs #304 and #305 are independent of each other and of other open PRs, so they can merge in any order.

friction: CPU contention from the still-running `t165-lints` forces trail 166 to wait.
A possible docs merge conflict with #300 on `docs/type-checker-integration.md`.
open_items: Read CI checks for #304 and #305, which have not been looked at yet.
Removing the two remaining module edges (plugin registry in `types/options.rs`, `DependencyLayer` in `resolver/mod.rs`) requires moving a type or making it generic, which is a separate decision.
If #300 merges first, merge `main` into #305 to resolve conflicts in `docs/type-checker-integration.md`.
Earlier PRs #291 and #299–#302 are still open.
